title: Pisces cries about a blind card
old_caption: Their blind card says they cry at weddings. And bakeries. Pisces may have found their person. Card first, face last.

title: Pisces cries about the last cookie
old_caption: A Taurus saved you the last cookie. Do you understand how big that is? Being thought of is the whole gift.

title: Pisces cries about last December
old_caption: Look at a photo of yourself from last December. Now look around. Be proud of who carried you here: you.

title: Pisces cries about a new leaf
old_caption: Your houseplant grew one new leaf in December and you need a minute. Growth is quiet. Notice it anyway.

title: Pisces cries about a snowman
old_caption: Someone built a snowman outside your window holding a sign with your name on it. In your colour scarf. Let people show up for you.

title: Pisces cries about saying no
old_caption: You said no to the party and braced for it. They said "totally, rest up." Relief tears count. A kind no is still a kind word.

title: Pisces cries about a talk card
old_caption: One talk card: what small thing makes you feel loved? Then they remembered your oat milk. Answer softly, listen longer.

title: Pisces cries about you
old_caption: Yes, you. You texted back, said sorry first and stayed kind this year. Pisces noticed. Feeling it all is its own courage.

title: They laughed at the terrible pun
old_caption:
Laughing at someone's terrible pun is a love language.
Pisces saw it happen and is not okay.

title: They saved me a seat
old_caption:
Running late and someone saved you a seat?
That's the whole love story. Pisces is sobbing into the popcorn.
